_note: What a question to Outrider (POST /api/ask: the tablet app's voice) is matched to, without any AI. Each command lists phrases; a question matches the first command, in this order, that has one of its phrases as whole words in it (case and punctuation ignored; a leading "hey vespa" or "vespa" is dropped). Hush takes a time from the question ("hush for ten minutes", "quiet until the next jump"). Edit freely: a command's phrases can change, but its name stays (it picks the answer). Unmatched questions go to the AI layer when [assistant] enabled is true. "descriptions": what each command does, for the list of voice commands (Settings → Voice, the tablet's Voice commands…).

travel_today: how far have i gone today
how far have i come today
how far did i go today

descriptions.unhush: Ends a hush: the voice speaks again.
descriptions.hush: Hushes the voice: for 30 minutes, or for 10 minutes or until the next jump when you say so (another time gets the nearer of 10 and 30 minutes). Danger lines still speak.
descriptions.nearest_ggg: The nearest body that could be a green gas giant, from what Outrider has cached: a guess from the ladder model, to check in the system map.
descriptions.nearest_dock: The nearest station or fleet carrier and what to know before docking there; a word in the question narrows it to a service, to stations or carriers, or to a material trader. A far one (500 light years by default) gets a neutron route plotted there.
descriptions.fsd_injection: How many premium, standard and basic FSD injections your materials make, and the material that runs short.
descriptions.travel_today: Jumps, light years, first discoveries, bodies mapped and samples since midnight; with "session" in the question, the latest session alone.
descriptions.left_behind: The nearest one or two systems within 100 light years with work worth going back for: bodies not found, planets worth mapping, biology.
descriptions.this_body: The body you are on or near, else the one targeted: its type, gravity, value now and if mapped, and its biological and geological signals.
descriptions.next_jump: The next stop of the route you follow (the Highway, Road to Riches, Exomastery, a world, sweep or trade route, the one plotted last; else your next stop, else the route plotted in the game): how far, a neutron star or not, what is left and the next refuel.
descriptions.status_report: Where you are, fuel, unsold credits and the Highway's next stop.
descriptions.fuel: Fuel in percent, about how many jumps it lasts at full range, and your jump range (supercharged too, when you are).
descriptions.unsold: The credits of the cartographic and exobiology data aboard, not yet sold.
descriptions.whats_left: What is still to do in this system: honk it, bodies to find, biology to sample, planets worth mapping.
descriptions.nearest_unvisited: The nearest system you have never visited, how far it is and whether its star is scoopable.
descriptions.bookmark_remove: Removes the bookmark of the system you are in.
descriptions.bookmark_here: Bookmarks the system you are in; any words after it are its note ("bookmark this system ringed water world").
descriptions.again: Says the last line again, in the window that speaks.
descriptions.where_am_i: The system you are in, its galactic region and the body you are on or near.
descriptions.show_page: Shows a page on the tablet ("show Nearby", "open Bio", "back to Now"): only with a page's name after it. Desktop windows stay where they are.
